 tap here to see other videos from our team . Play Video Article content The MMA fighter and OnlyFans star took on Canadian MMA veteran Shannon Clark at PFL Chicago on Saturday night.
 She began the fight well and held off Clark until she was dropped in the closing seconds of the first round.
 Pummelling left her exposed
 Clark, 34, continued her pummeling of the Mexican flyweight and by the third round, she unleashed a barrage of blows on her bloodied opponent.
 During the repeated strikes, Acosta’s bralette shifted out of position and left part of left breast exposed.
 She was unaware of the wardrobe malfunction, even as she turned on her side to protect herself, but the ref did and stopped the contest.
 What fans had to say
 Nevertheless, fans couldn’t help but notice the clothing mishap, which was shared online.
 Flexing her stuff. (Instagram/Loba Acosta) Photo by Loba Acosta / Instagram The consensus from fans was that it was, overall, a “great fight,” with one user adding: “And ends with a boob laying out.”
 Advertisement 3 Story continues below This advertisement has not loaded yet, but your article continues below. Article content Another wrote: “A wardrobe malfunction during a KO is rough,” while a third person noted that “Lucero was actually doing a great job in the 1st and 2nd.”
 One person complained that the match “should have been called way before” Acosta’s breast was exposed.
 However, another fan praised La Loba, pointing out that “the real story is how she kept fighting through that when most people would’ve just called it.”
 Acosta’s inadvertent flashing, (X) X It paid off
 Acosta took it all in stride, even joking about it on her Instagram.
 She shared a sexy snap of herself removing a black bra and included the caption: “Extra payment on @onlyfans because we showed our nipples during the @pflmma live.”
 The 32-year-old added: “It’s cute. Official Sponsor.”
 OnlyFans side hustle gets a boost. (Instagram/Loba Acosta) Photo by Loba Acosta / Instagram The fighter later shared a figure of $500,000 on her Instagram Stories, but did not clarify whether that number represented her total earnings, or perhaps a surge in revenue generated by her OnlyFans views.

 Clark, meanwhile, is now 9-1 as a pro following her third straight victory in the PFL.
